### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.completion

### Question

Is it possible to remove the title of those window ? With mini.notify, we can just make window.config.title an empty string.

Also, since handlers changed in neovim 0.11. How can I put a title to the hover window ?

comment_data.body:
> Is it possible to remove the title of those window ?

Not right now, no. Can I ask what is the motivation here? Personal dislike of titles in floating window or is there some usability issues?

The problem with this is that 'mini.completion' only supports selected fields for window config. Others are computed based on the several factors for every execution and exporting them would only bring troubles. It is possible, of course, to export configurable title, but that would also somewhat imply exporting `title_pos` (and maybe even `footer` + `footer_pos`) which goes against the overall design of having as small config as possible.

> Also, since handlers changed in neovim 0.11. How can I put a title to the hover window ?

I am not sure how this relates to 'mini.completion', as it doesn't implement any hover. Can you elaborate, please?

reply_data.body:
> Not right now, no. Can I ask what is the motivation here? Personal dislike of titles in floating window or is there some usability issues?

It's just my personal taste. I would like to have heither, a title for each floating window or none at all. And It was totally possible in neovim 0.10, since most of the native floating windows where configurable. But I was still curious to know if it where possible to change the config of the title of the mini plugins that use it.

> I am not sure how this relates to 'mini.completion', as it doesn't implement any hover. Can you elaborate, please?

Yeah, I'm sorry. It's a sneaky question I got when writing the post.
When I was on neovim 0.10, I added a title to most of the floating windows to have the same style as mini.notify, mini.completion and mini.clue. And to change the hover window I could use `vim.lsp.handlers['textDocument/hover']`. But since neovim 0.11 it got deprecated and only the border of floating window is configurable.
It was practical in a way I could disable focus of the floating window, which is no longer possible right now (at least, with the current config options).

reply_data.body:
> > Not right now, no. Can I ask what is the motivation here? Personal dislike of titles in floating window or is there some usability issues?
> 
> It's just my personal taste. I would like to have heither, a title for each floating window or none at all. And It was totally possible in neovim 0.10, since most of the native floating windows where configurable. But I was still curious to know if it where possible to change the config of the title of the mini plugins that use it.

Well, all floating windows in 'mini.nvim' have titles now. And indeed 'mini.completion' does not have a dedicated way to change the title. With the recent resolution of #1455, there is a hacky way to achieve that, though:

```lua
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('BufWinEnter', {
  callback = function(args)
    local buf_id = args.buf
    local completion_type = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(buf_id):match('^minicompletion://%d+/(.*)$')
    if completion_type == nil then return end

    local win_id = vim.fn.win_findbuf(buf_id)[1]
    local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(win_id)
    config.title = completion_type == 'item-info' and 'My new info' or 'My new signature'
    vim.api.nvim_win_set_config(win_id, config)
  end,
})
```

I'll take a moment to think whether I'd want to open the box of adding extra `title`/`title_pos`/etc. or whether this kind of solution would be enough (maybe behind custom event for each window?).

Sorry to reopen this, but the autocommand solution does not work anymore.
E.g the first info window shown when completion menu is open does not have a title as per the autocommand configuration bellow, but navigating throught the completions and showing other info windows seams to reset the config.

```lua
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('BufWinEnter', {
    desc = "Removes title from minicompletion windows",
    group = group,
    callback = function(args)
        local completion_type = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(args.buf):match('^minicompletion://%d+/(.*)$')
        if completion_type == nil then return end

        local win_id = vim.fn.win_findbuf(args.buf)[1]
        local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(win_id)
        config.title = ""
        vim.api.nvim_win_set_config(win_id, config)
    end,
})
```

I'll take a look into preserving "decorative" window config fields (like border and title).

comment_data.body:
@Gael-Lopes-Da-Silva, I am afraid there was once again a change in a recommended way to adjust titles in 'mini.completion'. There are now [dedicated events](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/c8d4b45745b9c05217d33c7841230af4d03a5f1b/doc/mini-completion.txt#L217-L219) for when info and signature windows are opened/updated.

So the suggested way is now less verbose and more performant. Here is an example:

```lua
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('User', {
  pattern = { 'MiniCompletionWindowOpen', 'MiniCompletionWindowUpdate' },
  callback = function(ev)
    local win_id, kind = ev.data.win_id, ev.data.kind
    local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(win_id)
    -- Change to `config.title = ''` to not show title
    config.title = 'Custom ' .. kind
    vim.api.nvim_win_set_config(win_id, config)
  end,
})
```

Sorry for the trouble.
